metadata.title: COSU Mobile International Travel Device SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan defining Corporate-Owned Single-Use (COSU) Mobile Devices issued for international travel to high-risk jurisdictions.

import-profile.remarks: This COSU SSPP inherits baseline controls from the Secure Endpoint Platform profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: A stripped-down, corporate-owned, single-use mobile device issued temporarily for international travel to high-risk jurisdictions. The device is designed to minimize data exposure, credential persistence, and post-travel risk through enforced reset or decommissioning.

props.name: inherits-from-sspp
props.remarks: COSU Mobile Travel Devices inherit endpoint governance but are not treated as standard mobile endpoints.

props.name: endpoint-class
props.remarks: Single-use COSU mobile endpoint for travel to high-risk jurisdictions.

props.name: execution-model
props.remarks: Execution is restricted to a minimal set of approved communication and authentication applications.

props.name: user-authentication-model
props.remarks: Authentication sessions are ephemeral and do not persist credentials beyond immediate use.

props.name: ownership-model
props.remarks: Device is owned, issued, and reclaimed by the institution.

props.name: management-model
props.remarks: Device operates under a special travel-mode management profile.

props.name: cryptographic-identity
props.remarks: Device identity is used solely for management, not service entitlement.

props.name: baseline-hardening
props.remarks: OS build disables app installation, backups, developer modes, cloud sync, and non-essential sensors.

props.name: network-access-model
props.remarks: Network access is limited to approved services using hardened transport and assumes hostile networks.

props.name: data-persistence
props.remarks: No institutional data is permitted to persist locally beyond in-memory session buffers.

props.name: eligible-data-classifications
props.remarks: Device may only be used for low-sensitivity communications and coordination.

props.name: non-equivalence-statement
props.remarks: A COSU Travel Device is not a Secure-Mobile platform and must not be used as a personal or managed smartphone.

props.name: inspection-assumption
props.remarks: Device inspection or seizure is assumed possible, informing design and controls.

props.name: lifecycle-governance
props.remarks: Device must be factory reset, reimaged, or destroyed after travel.

system-implementation.remarks: COSU Mobile International Travel Devices implement Secure Endpoint patterns with an extreme least-capability posture designed for hostile environments.

roles.title: International Travel Security Operations
roles.remarks: Responsible for issuance, monitoring, and post-travel handling of COSU Mobile Travel Devices.

roles.title: Information Security Governance
roles.remarks: Defines eligibility, approved applications, and jurisdictional risk thresholds.

control-implementation.remarks: Controls are enforced through extreme device hardening, data minimization, and lifecycle destruction workflows rather than trust assertion.
